requirements.text: Handoff must not depend on user-facing /wiki-session-handoff command dispatch for normal workflow.
Fresh-context handoffs must honestly represent Pi semantics and use a true terminal/process path only when adapter support exists.
Artifact wait/release must include a wake path for waiting sessions.
Handoff points must be policy-defined around loop/gateway boundaries and context health.
Pause narrow hotfix closure until broader handoff failures are researched and fixed or explicitly deferred.

evidence_mapping.criterion: Pi docs reviewed for session replacement semantics.
evidence_mapping.evidence: docs/extensions.md documents tools receive ExtensionContext while commands receive ExtensionCommandContext; ctx.newSession is command-only and uses withSession after replacement; no terminal-tab launcher appears in ExtensionAPI types or docs.
api.md and adapters.md require adapters to watch/subscribe to session queue and inject bounded wake messages for ready waiters.
validation-gateway.md now defines default handoff points for feedback/decision, documentation/planning, implementation, validation, task-close/publication, and artifact wait wakes.

summary: Document session handoff recovery model and Pi adapter constraints
knowledge_changes: .codewiki/kb/system/api.md: Session queue waits now require adapter wake/subscribe behavior; Pi new-session is documented as a fresh replacement session in the current terminal, not a portable new terminal tab; /wiki-session-handoff is compatibility executor rather than user workflow surface.

.codewiki/kb/system/adapters.md: Pi adapter constraints documented from current Pi extension docs: tools cannot call ctx.newSession, ctx.newSession replaces current session, withSession sends kickoff to replacement, no portable terminal-tab API, context-reset compaction can hide tool result, and artifact wait wake is adapter-owned.

.codewiki/kb/system/validation-gateway.md: Handoff policy now distinguishes feedback/decision continuity, documentation/planning context reset, implementation fresh start, validator independence, artifact wait wakes, and adapter fallback blocking.
.codewiki/kb/system/change-lifecycle.md: Chat is continuity only; builds/KB/roadmap/code/checks/validation are source of truth.
roadmap_changes: TASK-006 refined from narrow context-reset hotfix into broader session handoff orchestration stabilization task.
assumptions: Current Pi extension API lacks a portable way to open a new terminal tab; CodeWiki should implement honest fallback or external worker/orchestrator paths instead.
Auto-queued internal command remains a compatibility mechanism for command-context-only replacement until a richer adapter API or worker path exists.
open_questions: Should CodeWiki implement a terminal launcher config for optional true terminal-tab handoff in known terminals such as tmux, WezTerm, Kitty, or GNOME Terminal?
Should validation handoffs prefer a bounded worker-process Pi run over interactive replacement sessions when full independence is required?
How should ready wait wake messages avoid resuming stale work after a long wait beyond TTL or changed task scope?
